verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that telli records calls and that transcripts and recordings can be viewed in the app. The documented REST API covers only managing contacts and scheduling calls, and webhooks cover call events, status changes and outcomes. Nothing documents retrieving recordings or transcripts programmatically, for every call or otherwise, so in-app viewing is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can retrieve full call recordings and transcripts programmatically for every call
